newsitem.title: USA: Ion Laser cites multicenter test results.
newsitem.headline: Ion Laser cites multicenter test results.

text.p: Ion Laser Technology Inc said Friday that the initial findings of a multi-center laser bleaching study indicate that significant tooth whitening is obtained through its patented BriteSmile dual-laser, laser tooth whitening method.

Depending on the initial tooth color before treatment with laser bleaching, the darkest teeth whitened as many as 12 shades, said the company. The average of 8 to 8.5 shades is the result of different starting points for the teeth treated, with the darkest teeth achieving the greatest number of shade improvement.
Ion Laser Technology manufactures and markets precision laser instruments and chemical products for sale in the dental market.
